description: Screen-by-screen showcase preservation under pinned viewport, seed, frame, input tape, and host mode.

settings.staticFrames: Exact normalized terminal frame equality is required for declared exact lanes.
settings.interactive: State transitions and evidence streams must be compared from the same scripted inputs.
settings.partial: Similarity metrics are diagnostic observations only and never preservation decisions.
settings.hosts: Terminal and web runners must identify realization and host context separately.
settings.adapterResult: The exact JSON result is a normalized terminal frame; the normalization version and execution context are pinned by the verification plan.
